create_coco_evaluator: create a CocoEvaluator instance with ground truth COCO dataset and IoU types for bbox or segm evaluation
update_evaluator_predictions: update the CocoEvaluator with model predictions to compute per-image COCO evaluation results
summarize_coco_metrics: summarize COCO evaluation metrics including mAP across IoU types after accumulating results
convert_boxes_to_xywh: convert bounding boxes from xyxy format to xywh format using the convert_to_xywh helper function
prepare_coco_detection_results: prepare model predictions into COCO detection result format with image_id, category_id, bbox, and score fields
